# VoiceLK

> VoiceLK is a Sinhala-English code-switched text-to-speech platform. It combines text normalization, grapheme-to-phoneme processing and VITS-based neural speech synthesis for mixed-language speech.

This is the interactive VoiceLK web app at __SITE_URL__/. The product website, development journey and research articles are at https://voicelk.dev/.

The app has one public URL. Chat, History, Profile, Settings and Help are views inside that page, not separate public URLs. Private conversations and account information are not public reference material.

## Technical focus

Code-switching means using Sinhala and English within the same utterance. VoiceLK explores speech synthesis for this mixed-language input rather than treating each sentence as strictly monolingual.

The speech pipeline normalizes input text, maps Sinhala and English words into a shared phoneme sequence through a code-switched grapheme-to-phoneme (G2P) front-end, and synthesizes a waveform using VITS. Technical architecture and evaluation details are published on the product website linked below.

## Capabilities

- Use the conversational interface with Sinhala, English or mixed-language text.
- Read generated answers and play available Sinhala audio, with playback and download controls.
- Adjust playback speed and auto-play in Settings.
- Use the Model selector to view available speech models. Signed-out visitors can use the default model; other models require sign-in and backend availability.
- Sign in with email/password or Google to access account features, saved history and audio feedback.
- Switch between light and dark mode.

## Access and limitations

Visitors can start without signing in. Signed-out audio generation is limited; the app displays the remaining allowance and prompts for sign-in when needed. Availability and limits are controlled by the service, so do not promise unlimited usage or that every response has audio.

Generated responses and pronunciations can contain errors. Speech quality depends on input text and the selected model. Do not describe unimplemented data-export or bulk-history-deletion controls as working features.
